messages:
maria_support: FYI incoming escalation from Acme — streaming response cuts off before final token; client sees incomplete JSON and no finish_reason. customer says it started after a DTO update.
customer_acme: our prod users hit this intermittently since 03/05 10:12 UTC. curl -N shows stream ends abruptly. snippet below:
customer_acme: ```
data: {"id":"resp_01","object":"token","delta":{"content":"... their last sentence starts here and"
data: {"id":"resp_01","object":"token","delta":{"content":" continues but then"
// connection closes, no data: {"id":"resp_01","object":"finish","finish_reason":"stop"}
```
customer_acme: client lib receives EOF and fails JSON parse. finish_reason field absent. logs attached (I truncated). Priority: high, affects billing flow.
maria_support: thx. any pattern on model / region / SDK? Ashwin can you triage?
ashwin_engineer: looking. customer using hosted API -> model: gpt-open-2.2, region: us-west-2, SDK: node-fetch via serverless lambda. Repro locally with curl -> intermittent. I can reproduce ~1/10 requests.
ashwin_engineer: captured tcp dump, attached. pattern: last SSE event is partial JSON (unterminated object) then socket RST. Example from dump:
ashwin_engineer: ```
data: {"id":"resp_01","object":"token","delta":{"content":"...final phrase","role":"assistant"}}
data: {"id":"resp_01","object":"token","delta":{"content":"\n"}}data: {"id":"resp_01","object":"finish","finish_reason":
<socket close>
```
ashwin_engineer: finish_reason not sent because final frame didn't flush. probable root causes: proxy idle timeout, or server-side worker crash during final flush.
liz_oncall: seeing related alerts on us-west-2 edge proxy: 504 then connection close around the same window. deploy-bot: recent deploy to edge-proxy: v2.14.2 at 2026-03-05T09:50:00Z
deploy-bot: NOTE: edge-proxy v2.14.2 introduced buffered writes optimization.
ashwin_engineer: repro steps I used:
ashwin_engineer: ```bash
# reproducible with curl using keepalive
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -N \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-open-2.2","prompt":"long output test"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream
```
ashwin_engineer: mitigation that worked in my env: disabling proxy buffering or set proxy timeout > 60s. When I force a final flush at server side, client receives finish_reason.
maria_support: customer: can you try pointing to us-east-1 or temporarily bumping keepalive timeouts? also ask them to capture raw tcp when it reproduces.
customer_acme: I can test region failover today. If we hit this again I'll capture tcp dump. any ETA?
ashwin_engineer: short-term: recommend customer set region to us-east-1 and enable retry/resume on client. mid-term: engineering to investigate edge-proxy buffered-write optimization.
liz_oncall: filing incident ticket and assigning to eng-runtime. severity: P2 (customer data flow affected).
maria_support: I'll reply to customer with repro steps and ask for logs. /cc @ashwin_engineer @liz_oncall :thumbsup:
customer_acme: thanks — will test and report back.
ashwin_engineer: next steps for eng-runtime: 1) reproduce with proxy buffering toggled 2) add extra flush on final SSE event if worker about to terminate 3) add server side heartbeat to avoid proxy idle-closing during tail flush. I'll open a PR if repro confirmed.
liz_oncall: logging ticket: INC-2026-1187, linked to deploy v2.14.2. tagging for rollback if we see spike.
maria_support: closing loop with customer once they confirm. short thread for now.
